react_native_issues.issue: router.replace() is called during render (lines 41 and 45 of /app/frontend/app/distributor/index.tsx). React logs a console warning: 'Cannot update a component (NavigationContainerInner) while rendering a different component (DistributorHome)'. Wrap the redirect in useEffect (or use a <Redirect /> component) to satisfy React's rules-of-rendering. Non-blocking (redirect still works).

action_items: (Minor/RN best-practice) In /app/frontend/app/distributor/index.tsx, move the two router.replace() calls (currently inside the render body at lines 41 and 45) into a useEffect so setState-in-render warning goes away. Same pattern likely exists on other role-guarded screens - grep for 'router.replace' inside component bodies.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/admin/targets correctly deactivates prior active targets before inserting; consider adding an index on (salesperson_id, period, active) for lookup speed at scale.
server.py GET /api/performance recomputes leaderboard per-request over all orders in current month; fine for MVP, but consider caching or aggregation pipeline for larger datasets.
server.py GET /api/admin/attendance-report validates YYYY-MM using slice indexing then int(); reasonable and returns 400 on failure. calendar.monthrange handles Feb/leap-year correctly.
distributor/index.tsx: role-guard redirect uses router.replace during render — should be useEffect (see react_native_issues).
